title: Book an architecture review
summary: Present the design of a new or much changed critical system to the Architecture Board before building it, and get its advice in writing. Expected for tier 0 and tier 1 systems.

resources.title: Design document template
resources.description: Context diagram, data flows, failure modes, security and cost.

resources.title: Board calendar
resources.description: The board meets every second Thursday; slots close a week before.

prerequisites.title: Decision records for the main choices
prerequisites.description: The board reads them before the meeting; they keep the discussion short.

prerequisites.title: Sponsor agreed to the project
prerequisites.description: Someone with budget has said yes to the work.

actors.name: You
actors.description: The lead engineer or solution architect of the project.

steps.title: Write the design document
instructions: Draw the context diagram and the main data flows.
Describe what happens when each dependency fails.

steps.title: Book a slot with the board
instructions: Create a Jira ticket in the ARCH project of type 'Review request'.
Attach the design document and choose a date from the board calendar.

steps.title: Read the design and send questions
Present the design
instructions: Answer the written questions in the first five minutes.
Walk through the context diagram and the failure modes.
Note every piece of advice the board gives.

steps.title: Record the advice on the ticket
steps.description: The board writes its advice and conditions on the Jira ticket and closes it.
